closy.dynamic_reference.z2.v1.aggregationRule: every frame and every mandatory metric must pass; any nonfinite, missing, uncertain, or culling false-negative witness fails
closy.dynamic_reference.z2.v1.comparisonDirection: errors and cracks at_or_below maxima; containment margins at_or_above minima; counts exact
closy.dynamic_reference.z2.v1.rationale: caps are above float canonicalisation noise but below the fixed D0 render/binding inspection sensitivity

closy.outfit_surface.d0.v1.aggregationRule: all static and timestamped cases pass; oracle-uncertain witnesses fail closed
closy.outfit_surface.d0.v1.comparisonDirection: clearance and retained ratios at_or_above minima; penetration, order, strain, runtime, and memory at_or_below maxima
closy.outfit_surface.d0.v1.rationale: provisional D0 functional-reference limits preserve existing penetration budget and require exact layer order

closy.phase9_e1.selective.v1.aggregationRule: all absolute bars pass and the learned model must meet or exceed every equal-input baseline criterion without hidden-label fallback
closy.phase9_e1.selective.v1.comparisonDirection: accuracy, coverage, OOD correct action at_or_above minima; ECE and selective risk at_or_below maxima
closy.phase9_e1.selective.v1.rationale: requires useful selective coverage, improved calibration over PR #26, robust OOD action, and no worse equal-input baseline

closy.phase9_e2.typed_program.v1.aggregationRule: all structural and 3D bars pass on group-disjoint holdout and learned output meets or exceeds equal-input baselines
closy.phase9_e2.typed_program.v1.comparisonDirection: validity, exact structure, holdout quality, and baseline delta at_or_above minima; geometric errors at_or_below maxima
closy.phase9_e2.typed_program.v1.rationale: bounded first E2 profile requires genuine typed-program diversity, group holdout, and settled 3D quality

closy.surface_equivalence.z1.v1.aggregationRule: every repaired family, parameter case, local region, and whole surface must pass; exact-equality fields are conjunctive
closy.surface_equivalence.z1.v1.comparisonDirection: deviations at_or_below maxima; silhouette IoU at_or_above minimum; inventory counts exact
closy.surface_equivalence.z1.v1.rationale: local conforming retriangulation should preserve the represented settled surface to numerical sampling precision while removing processor-invalid topology
